create_dataset_instance: create a YourOwnDataset instance from a data directory with train split and downsample factor
load_rays_and_rgbs: load all rays and RGB values from transforms JSON for neural rendering training
read_depth_from_pfm: read a PFM depth map file and return it as a float32 numpy array
convert_world_to_ndc: convert 3D world coordinates to normalized device coordinates using scene center and radius
compute_projection_matrix: compute the projection matrix from camera intrinsics and poses for each frame
